statement: No part of the assembly - frame, flight controller, motors, props, battery, strap, screws, wires - shares material with another, except the declared threaded, plugged and soldered joints
rationale: Measured by boolean intersection of every placed part with every other (model/assembly.py), not of boxes standing in for them: the props as blades, the motor leads along their real route out through the duct's port window. Allowed overlaps are listed with their reasons in assembly.ALLOWED_OVERLAPS. Overlaps under 1e-4 mm3 (faces that touch) are not counted. REVISED 2026-10-07 from bought-part envelopes, which could not see a wire.
